name: Compact
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: More on a screen without crowding it: a 15 px sans with tight lines and paragraphs on warm Gruvbox paper, headings set apart by colour rather than size. For lists, logs and quick notes. Density and colours after Shimmering Focus, our own CSS.

zh.description: 一屏放下更多内容又不显拥挤：15 px 无衬线字体，行距和段距收紧，底色是 Gruvbox 的暖色纸面，标题靠颜色而不是字号区分。适合清单、日志和速记。密度与配色参考 Shimmering Focus，CSS 为我们自己编写。
